lane_impact: L1 world-exploration: corrects the surveyor's farming table before it reaches src/config. Types 1-3 all carry the explicit three-way ladder gated on timePeriod + gracePeriod; type 4 is two-way. Porting a uniform rot rule would destroy the 12 h crop's only advantage.
text: The 12-hour crop (plantType 4) has no ROTTED branch at all - once ready it stays harvestable forever, so the '15-minute grace before ROT' rule applies only to the 15 min / 1 h / 6 h crops.
